# The file lists of the published Better OS 0.2.9 packages, as dpkg reports
# them. They are the only record of which systemd user units a component owns,
# so the unit discovery is tested against the real thing rather than a list
# written by hand.
#
# Read with:
#   gh release download v0.2.9 -p 'better-*_0.2.9_ubuntu-24.04_amd64.deb' -D <dir>
#   dpkg-deb -c <dir>/better-awake_0.2.9_ubuntu-24.04_amd64.deb
#
# The packages themselves are not committed. Each section below is the verbatim
# output for the package it names, one section per package. Better Awake,
# Better Monitor, Better Storage, and Better Touchpad each install exactly one
# user unit; better-manager-daemon is here because its unit lives on the system
# bus and must not be mistaken for a user unit.
